about: Categorization evals (Phase 4B, B1; brief §3; CC-19, CC-20). Written by hand from patterns, never from real users' data. Run by supabase/functions/_shared/semantic/categories.test.ts (free, in CI). An item defaults to kind fact, subject person, certainty stated, user_state unreviewed; quotes default to the line itself.
